system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 15 minutes, 10 Spell Uses. Lasts: 3 hours. A 30 feet circle around the caster. Name up to five things; all instances of them cannot cross the circle (for instance crossbow bolts). Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
